nodes.label: Privacy-first, offline, local-only architecture
nodes.rationale: Works offline, needs no account, shows no ads, keeps data on the device. The app runs no servers and collects nothing: no cloud sync, no analytics SDK, no advertising SDK. Contributions must keep the app offline-first and free of tracking.

nodes.label: Feature-first architecture (lib/features, lib/core)
nodes.rationale: lib/features/<feature>/ holds screens; lib/core/ holds models, providers, database and theme. CHANGELOG 1.0.0 lists it as chosen for scalability.

nodes.label: APPLY_STANDARD_SETTINGS (Linux)
nodes.rationale: Applies C++14, -Wall -Werror, and -O3/NDEBUG outside Debug. Kept minimal because plugins call it by default; new options belong on specific targets.

nodes.label: Linux relocatable bundle install
nodes.rationale: Install builds a relocatable bundle (data/, lib/ with $ORIGIN/lib rpath). The unbundled executable is emitted to intermediates_do_not_run because only the bundled copy finds its resources. flutter_assets is wiped and re-copied on each install to avoid stale files; the AOT library is installed only for non-Debug builds.

nodes.label: flutter INTERFACE library (Linux GTK)
nodes.rationale: Wraps libflutter_linux_gtk.so plus GTK, GLib and GIO pkg-config targets as one interface target that the runner and plugins link.

nodes.label: flutter_assemble custom target (Linux)
nodes.rationale: Runs tool_backend.sh through a custom command whose outputs include a non-existent _phony_ file so it executes on every build, since the flutter tool exposes no full input/output list.

nodes.label: Flutter artifact paths published to parent scope (Linux: FLUTTER_LIBRARY, FLUTTER_ICU_DATA_FILE, AOT_LIBRARY, PROJECT_BUILD_DIR)
nodes.norm_label: flutter artifact paths published to parent scope (linux: flutter_library, flutter_icu_data_file, aot_library, project_build_dir)

nodes.label: list_prepend
nodes.rationale: Stand-in for list(TRANSFORM ... PREPEND ...), which is unavailable in the CMake 3.10 minimum this file targets.

nodes.label: Linux runner executable (main.cc, my_application.cc, generated_plugin_registrant.cc)
nodes.rationale: Named via BINARY_NAME from the top-level CMakeLists so `flutter run` keeps working; APPLICATION_ID is injected as a preprocessor define.

nodes.label: APPLY_STANDARD_SETTINGS (Windows)
nodes.rationale: Applies C++17, /W4 /WX with warning 4100 suppressed, /EHsc and _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0, plus _DEBUG in Debug. Same caution as Linux: plugins use it by default so it stays minimal.

nodes.label: Windows in-place install next to executable
nodes.norm_label: windows in-place install next to executable
nodes.rationale: Support files are copied beside the executable rather than into a separate bundle (as on Linux) so building and running from within Visual Studio works; install is added to the default VS build; the AOT library is installed only for Profile and Release configurations.

nodes.label: flutter_assemble custom target (Windows)
nodes.rationale: Runs tool_backend.bat for the active $<CONFIG>; a SYMBOLIC _phony_ output forces it to run every build because the flutter tool exposes no full input/output list. Also produces the cpp_client_wrapper sources.

nodes.label: Private by Design
nodes.rationale: Health data stays in a local on-device database: no account, no cloud, no analytics, no advertising SDKs. Backup/restore is a user-controlled JSON file, location is optional and used only to choose a food region, and AI summaries can be routed to the user's own Ollama server instead of a hosted service. Positioned as the reason to pick this tracker over ones that collect health data.
